title: astragalus vaseyi var. deanei
intro: Astragalus vaseyi var. deanei, commonly known as Deane's milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family. It is a type of legume that is native to the mountainous regions of North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including immune system support, anti-inflammatory effects, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Deane's milkvetch include isoflavones, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including immune modulation, anti-inflammatory effects, and antioxidant activity.
